interaction.accessibleLabel: Submit the 0 mL stock / 10 mL water concentration calculated with M1V1 = M2V2.
interaction.successCue: The standard's concentration is recorded in micromolar.
interaction.invalidCue: Record the teacher-supplied stock concentration first; the investigation supplies no default.

nodes.title: Record stock concentration
nodes.description: Enter the stock molarity supplied by the teacher. The investigation intentionally provides no default value.

feedback.retry: Review record stock concentration and try again.

nodes.title: Record dilution assignments
nodes.description: Identify which ratio(s) this group prepares and which classmates contribute the other rows. The simulator replays the complete source-labeled class series without changing the physical classroom assignments.

feedback.retry: Review record dilution assignments and try again.

nodes.title: Label 10 mL stock / 0 mL water
nodes.description: Label the assigned test tube 10 mL stock / 0 mL water. Keep this ratio attached to every later reading and pooled row.

feedback.success: Label 10 mL stock / 0 mL water complete.
feedback.retry: Review label 10 ml stock / 0 ml water and try again.

nodes.title: Measure 10 mL stock
nodes.description: Use the 10 mL graduated pipette to measure the assigned stock volume for 10 mL stock / 0 mL water.

feedback.retry: Review measure 10 ml stock and try again.

nodes.title: Transfer measured stock
nodes.description: Deliver the measured stock to the test tube labeled 10 mL stock / 0 mL water.

feedback.retry: Review transfer measured stock and try again.

nodes.title: Confirm zero water
nodes.description: Do not add water to the 10 mL stock / 0 mL water tube.

feedback.retry: Review confirm zero water and try again.

nodes.title: Calculate standard molarity
nodes.description: Use M1V1=M2V2 with the teacher-supplied stock molarity, 10 mL stock, and 10 mL total volume.
